semiconductor_relevance: Medium — RS CO., LTD provides essential components and systems for semiconductor facility infrastructure, such as gas supply systems and CVD equipment.
summary: RS CO., LTD specializes in supplying critical materials and components for semiconductor and IT industry infrastructure. Their offerings include clean ball valves, diaphragm pumps, and gas regulators, which are essential for utility lines and facility systems like CCSS, wet stations, and CVD equipment. The company focuses on quality and cost-effectiveness in meeting customer needs.
